problem: The public NL/EN selector could exist in the legacy mobile navigation while the visible shared mobile navigation replaced and hid that legacy DOM.
root_cause: The i18n layer and shared mobile navigation had split ownership. The selector was mounted into #bgkopMob before menu.js promoted a separate #bgSharedMobileNav, so the active visible navigation was not guaranteed to contain the language control.
prevention: The shared mobile navigation must preserve an existing mobile language control when it promotes the legacy navigation.
The i18n runtime must remount controls when the shared mobile navigation announces readiness.
Static i18n reconciliation must still run mobile-language injection even when i18n assets were already injected.
Production browser proof must exercise the visible mobile NL to EN to NL control.

evidence.failure: visible mobile language select is missing
